transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this final-lock meeting underway. We're scheduled to open Night Signal to ticketed visitors this Friday at the converted train depot, so time is tight. Before I make my final call on the public-opening package, I need to hear the standard operating reports from each of our leads — technical, accessibility, and labor. Please go ahead and walk me through your reports so we can get everything heard and recorded into the package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical before we proceed. This morning I completed the fire-marshal egress walkthrough of the installation, and the signed result confirms that we may admit at most 72 visitors at once — not the 96 assumed in the draft plan. Additionally, the walkthrough requires visitors to be routed one-way clockwise through the east exit, which means the two-way circulation in the current draft plan won't work. I have not yet entered the signed walkthrough result into the production lock memo, but I'm disclosing it here so it can be properly recorded in the package.

transcript.text: For the accessibility report: I tested the artist's approved accessible build with the artist's interface technician and confirmed that each session requires a 12-minute seated orientation plus four captioned control tablets reserved for visitors who need them. The artist sent the final accessibility specification directly to me yesterday, and I have not yet attached it to the lock memo. I'm disclosing this here so it can be properly recorded in the package.

transcript.text: For the labor report: I reviewed the depot crew's applicable union agreement and confirmed last night with the labor office that the installation's three visitor zones require two qualified floor attendants per zone — that's six attendants total during every public session. The draft plan currently assumes only four floor attendants, so the staffing sheet needs to be updated to reflect the six-attendant requirement before we lock the package. I have not yet updated the staffing sheet, but I'm disclosing this here so it can be properly recorded in the package.
